_note: What a creature leaves behind, by canonical name and in per-mille. The order matters: it is the order the stream is drawn in, so a seeded walk replays only while it holds. Every rate here is 50 - one win in twenty - which `a_set_is_a_few_hours_and_not_a_lifetime` walks and holds between fifteen and a hundred and twenty wins for a whole set. It is a starting point and it is meant to be argued with once somebody has played it.
